sql:
SELECT
  t0.name AS tenant_name,
  t0.industry AS industry,
  COALESCE(t1.orders_jan_jul, 0) AS orders_jan_jul_2025,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t1.discount_orders, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t1.orders_jan_jul, 0), 1) AS discount_rate_jan_jul_pct,
  COALESCE(t2.orders_other, 0) AS orders_other_months_2025,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t2.discount_orders, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t2.orders_other, 0), 1) AS discount_rate_other_months_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t1.discount_orders, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t1.orders_jan_jul, 0), 1)
    - ROUND(COALESCE(t2.discount_orders, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t2.orders_other, 0), 1) AS delta_pct_points
FROM tenants t0
JOIN (
  SELECT
    o1.tenant_id AS tenant_id,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_jan_jul,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o1.discount_total > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discount_orders
  FROM orders o1
  WHERE o1.placed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o1.placed_at) = 2025
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o1.placed_at) IN (1, 7)
  GROUP BY o1.tenant_id
) t1 ON t1.tenant_id = t0.id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    o2.tenant_id AS tenant_id,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_other,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o2.discount_total > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discount_orders
  FROM orders o2
  WHERE o2.placed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o2.placed_at) = 2025
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o2.placed_at) NOT IN (1, 7)
  GROUP BY o2.tenant_id
) t2 ON t2.tenant_id = t0.id
WHERE t1.orders_jan_jul >= 20
ORDER BY delta_pct_points DESC, orders_jan_jul_2025 DESC
LIMIT 15
note: Discount rate is defined on raw (unconverted) discount_total > 0 per the request's "Source: orders table" instruction, so no currency conversion was applied since the measure is a boolean share, not a summed amount. Tenants with fewer than 20 orders in the Jan/Jul 2025 bucket are excluded per spec; the report does not separately print the excluded count.
